reviews.t: Best leave in I've ever found

I ran out and found it on here so I ordered it. I saved my old bottle though and when I got my new one I poured half into my ild bottle and then filled both the rest of the way up with water to dilute it 50%. It was perfect before but sometimes I can tend to overspray and I just wanted to use less product on my hair.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product for leaving hair soft and not greasy or weighed down.
Many reviewers love the pleasant scent.
Several reviewers have used and repurchased the product for years, often for themselves and their children.
A few reviewers highlight the lightweight, non-greasy formula as ideal for fine or oily hair.
One reviewer found the product drying rather than moisturizing.
